Complete sample-based script for review:

import pandas as pd
from io import StringIO

SAMPLE_DATA = (
    "Order Number,Order Date,Status,Quantity\n"
    "ORD-5B048F,2026-09-02,Confirmed,108\n"
    "ORD-542FDA,2026-09-02,Confirmed,68\n"
    "ORD-6C71B1,2026-09-02,Cancelled,50\n"
    "ORD-12AAA3,2026-09-02,Cancelled,20\n"
    "ORD-7B1234,2026-09-01,Confirmed,15\n"
)

TARGET_DATE = pd.Timestamp("2026-09-02")
OUTPUT_FILE = "confirmed_orders_2026-09-02.txt"

# Load the supplied sample without accessing or modifying an Excel workbook.
orders = pd.read_csv(StringIO(SAMPLE_DATA))

# Validate the input schema.
required_columns = {
    "Order Number",
    "Order Date",
    "Status",
    "Quantity",
}
missing_columns = required_columns.difference(orders.columns)

if missing_columns:
    raise ValueError(
        "Missing required columns: "
        + ", ".join(sorted(missing_columns))
    )

# Normalize order numbers and treat whitespace-only values as missing.
orders["Order Number"] = (
    orders["Order Number"]
    .fillna("")
    .astype(str)
    .str.strip()
)

# Parse dates robustly; invalid values become NaT and do not qualify.
order_dates = pd.to_datetime(
    orders["Order Date"],
    errors="coerce",
).dt.normalize()

# Normalize status for case-insensitive matching.
normalized_status = (
    orders["Status"]
    .fillna("")
    .astype(str)
    .str.strip()
    .str.casefold()
)

# Select only explicit Confirmed records on the target date.
confirmed_orders = orders.loc[
    order_dates.eq(TARGET_DATE)
    & normalized_status.eq("confirmed")
    & orders["Order Number"].ne(""),
    ["Order Number", "Quantity"],
].copy()

# Write only order number and quantity, with no header or index.
confirmed_orders.to_csv(
    OUTPUT_FILE,
    index=False,
    header=False,
    sep=",",
    lineterminator="\n",
)

output_preview = confirmed_orders.to_csv(
    index=False,
    header=False,
    sep=",",
    lineterminator="\n",
).rstrip()

print(output_preview)
print(f"Saved {len(confirmed_orders)} orders to {OUTPUT_FILE}")

Expected file content:

ORD-5B048F,108
ORD-542FDA,68

This version interprets “only confirmed orders” strictly, so blank, cancelled, and other status values do not qualify.
